title: Sign your Hub71 acceptance letter
detail: Signed by Hub71's CEO and the founder(s). Opens the Hub71 portal, starting with Clara and WeWork.

title: Complete KYC on Clara
detail: Upload your KYC and due diligence documents on Clara.

title: Get your establishment card
detail: Not covered in Hub71's onboarding guide. Verify with ADGM.

title: Sign the Hub71 incentives agreement
detail: Sign right after the licence. Unlocks AED 250,000 in services from 30+ approved providers.

title: Open your business bank account
detail: Needs your ADGM licence and your Emirates ID.

title: Complete company stitching
detail: Share transfer from the ADGM operating company to the holding company. About 2 weeks.

title: Sign the Hub71 SAFE
detail: AED 250,000 SAFE, no discount and no valuation cap. Funds 3–4 working days after the share transfer.

title: Set up in your Hub71 workspace
detail: Ask Hub71 which workspace options come with your programme.

title: Relocate your first hires
detail: Invite hires so each one gets their own plan, and track their progress.

title: Join Hub71 community sessions
detail: Ask Hub71 about upcoming sessions, mentors and partner access.
